}

	Beneficiary         common.Address
	EtherAmount         *big.Int
	JobDescription      string
	TransactionBytecode []byte
}

func (m DAO_NewProposal_Method) Name() string      { return "newProposal" }
func (m DAO_NewProposal_Method) MethodID() [4]byte { return [4]byte{0xb1, 0x05, 0x0d, 0xa5} }
func (m DAO_NewProposal_Method) Pack(beneficiary common.Address, etherAmount *big.Int, jobDescription string, transactionBytecode []byte) []byte {
	return dAOMust(m.TryPack(beneficiary, etherAmount, jobDescription, transactionBytecode))
}
func (m DAO_NewProposal_Method) TryPack(beneficiary common.Address, etherAmount *big.Int, jobDescription string, transactionBytecode []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	return _DAOABI.Pack(m.Name(), beneficiary, etherAmount, jobDescription, transactionBytecode)
}
func (m DAO_NewProposal_Method) UnpackInput(callData []byte) (beneficiary common.Address, etherAmount *big.Int, jobDescription string, transactionBytecode []byte, err error) {
	input, err := dAOUnpackInput[DAO_NewProposal_Input](m.Name(), callData)
	if err != nil {
		return *new(common.Address), new(big.Int), *new(string), *new([]byte), err
	}
	return input.Beneficiary, input.EtherAmount, input.JobDescription, input.TransactionBytecode, nil
}

	ctx context.Context,
	client contractcall.ISendTxClient,
	addr common.Address,
	tx contractcall.TxOpts,
	beneficiary common.Address,
	etherAmount *big.Int,
	jobDescription string,
	transactionBytecode []byte,
) (*types.Transaction, error) {
	return contractcall.SendTxE(ctx, client, tx.ChainID, tx.Value, m.Pack(beneficiary, etherAmount, jobDescription, transactionBytecode), &addr, tx.Payer, tx.Manager, tx.BeforeSend, tx.NoSend, true, tx.Options...)

	out0 := dAOConvertType[*big.Int](out[0])
	return out0, nil
}

	input.EtherAmount = dAOConvertType[*big.Int](arguments[1])
	input.JobDescription = dAOConvertType[string](arguments[2])
	input.TransactionBytecode = dAOConvertType[[]byte](arguments[3])
}

// UnpackInput attempts to decode the provided call data using contract method definitions.
func (dAO *DAO) UnpackInput(callData []byte) (any, error) {
	if len(callData) < 4 {
		return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["changeMembership"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_ChangeMembership_Input]("changeMembership", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["changeVotingRules"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_ChangeVotingRules_Input]("changeVotingRules", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["checkProposalCode"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_CheckProposalCode_Input]("checkProposalCode", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["debatingPeriodInMinutes"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAO.DebatingPeriodInMinutes, nil
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["executeProposal"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_ExecuteProposal_Input]("executeProposal", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["majorityMargin"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAO.MajorityMargin, nil
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["memberId"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_MemberId_Input]("memberId", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["members"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_Members_Input]("members", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["minimumQuorum"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAO.MinimumQuorum, nil
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["newProposal"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_NewProposal_Input]("newProposal", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["numProposals"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAO.NumProposals, nil
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["owner"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAO.Owner, nil
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["proposals"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_Proposals_Input]("proposals", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["transferOwnership"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_TransferOwnership_Input]("transferOwnership", callData)
	}
	if bytes.Equal(callData[:4], _DAOABI.Methods["vote"].ID[:4]) {
		return dAOUnpackInput[DAO_Vote_Input]("vote", callData)
	}
	return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
}

// DAO_ChangeOfRules_Event is the Go binding around the ChangeOfRules contract event.
// Topic0: 0xa439d3fa452be5e0e1e24a8145e715f4fd8b9c08c96a42fd82a855a85e5d57de
// Solidity: event ChangeOfRules(uint256 minimumQuorum, uint256 debatingPeriodInMinutes, int256 majorityMargin)

	MajorityMargin          *big.Int

	return common.HexToHash("0xa439d3fa452be5e0e1e24a8145e715f4fd8b9c08c96a42fd82a855a85e5d57de")
}

}

const DAO_Voted_EventName = "Voted"

func (e DAO_Voted_Event) Name() string { return DAO_Voted_EventName }
func (e DAO_Voted_Event) Topic0() common.Hash {
	return common.HexToHash("0xc34f869b7ff431b034b7b9aea9822dac189a685e0b015c7d1be3add3f89128e8")
}
func (e DAO_Voted_Event) Unpack(log *types.Log) (*DAO_Voted_Event, error) {
	return dAOUnpackEvent[DAO_Voted_Event](e.Name(), log)
}
func (out *DAO_Voted_Event) unpack(values []any) {
	out.ProposalID = dAOConvertType[*big.Int](values[0])
	out.Position = dAOConvertType[bool](values[1])
	out.Voter = dAOConvertType[common.Address](values[2])
	out.Justification = dAOConvertType[string](values[3])
}
func (out *DAO_Voted_Event) setRaw(log *types.Log) { out.Raw = log }

// UnpackEvent unpacks event log based on topic0.
func (dAO *DAO) UnpackEvent(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
	if len(log.Topics) == 0 {
		return nil, errNoEventSignature
	}
	for _, item := range dAOEventUnpackers {
		if item.id == log.Topics[0] {
			return item.unpack(log)
		}
	}
	return nil, errEventSignatureMismatch
}

type dAOEventUnpacker struct {
	id     common.Hash
	unpack func(*types.Log) (any, error)
}

type dAOErrorUnpacker struct {
	id     [4]byte
	unpack func([]byte) (any, error)
}

var dAOEventUnpackers = []dAOEventUnpacker{
	{id: common.HexToHash("0xa439d3fa452be5e0e1e24a8145e715f4fd8b9c08c96a42fd82a855a85e5d57de"), unpack: func(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
		return (DAO_ChangeOfRules_Event{}).Unpack(log)
	}},
	{id: common.HexToHash("0x27b022af4a8347100c7a041ce5ccf8e14d644ff05de696315196faae8cd50c9b"), unpack: func(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
		return (DAO_MembershipChanged_Event{}).Unpack(log)
	}},
	{id: common.HexToHash("0x646fec02522b41e7125cfc859a64fd4f4cefd5dc3b6237ca0abe251ded1fa881"), unpack: func(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
		return (DAO_ProposalAdded_Event{}).Unpack(log)
	}},
	{id: common.HexToHash("0xd220b7272a8b6d0d7d6bcdace67b936a8f175e6d5c1b3ee438b72256b32ab3af"), unpack: func(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
		return (DAO_ProposalTallied_Event{}).Unpack(log)
	}},
	{id: common.HexToHash("0xc34f869b7ff431b034b7b9aea9822dac189a685e0b015c7d1be3add3f89128e8"), unpack: func(log *types.Log) (any, error) {
		return (DAO_Voted_Event{}).Unpack(log)
	}},
}

func dAOMust[T any](val T, err error) T {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return val
}

func dAOConvertType[T any](value any) T {
	return *abi.ConvertType(value, new(T)).(*T)
}

func dAOCallRaw(ctx context.Context, client bind.ContractCaller, addr common.Address, opts *bind.CallOpts, input []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	var callOpts bind.CallOpts
	if opts != nil {
		callOpts = *opts
	}
	callOpts.Context = ctx
	return bind.NewBoundContract(addr, *_DAOABI, client, nil, nil).CallRaw(&callOpts, input)
}

func dAOUnpackInput[T any](name string, callData []byte) (*T, error) {
	method, ok := _DAOABI.Methods[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("method '" + name + "' not found")
	}
	if len(callData) < 4 || !bytes.Equal(callData[:4], method.ID[:4]) {
		return nil, errMethodSignatureMismatch
	}
	arguments, err := method.Inputs.Unpack(callData[4:])
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	input := new(T)
	any(input).(interface{ unpack([]any) }).unpack(arguments)
	return input, nil
}

func dAOUnpackEvent[T any](name string, log *types.Log) (*T, error) {
	event, ok := _DAOABI.Events[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("event '" + name + "' not found")
	}
	if len(log.Topics) == 0 {
		return nil, errNoEventSignature
	}
	if log.Topics[0] != event.ID {
		return nil, errEventSignatureMismatch
	}
	var values []any
	if len(log.Data) > 0 {
		var err error
		values, err = event.Inputs.Unpack(log.Data)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	out := new(T)
	eventData := any(out).(interface {
		unpack([]any)
		setRaw(*types.Log)
	})
	eventData.unpack(values)
	var indexed abi.Arguments
	for _, arg := range event.Inputs {
		if arg.Indexed {
			indexed = append(indexed, arg)
		}
	}
	if err := abi.ParseTopics(out, indexed, log.Topics[1:]); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	eventData.setRaw(log)
	return out, nil
}
